load_pretrained_model: use torch hub to load a pretrained fairseq model by name via the dynamically exposed model functions
tokenize_with_bpe: use the bpe hub interface to apply byte pair encoding tokenization to input text
tokenize_with_tokenizer: use the tokenizer hub interface to tokenize input text with a fairseq tokenizer
check_dependencies: review the hubconf module to verify all required dependencies like torch and hydra are installed
build_cython_components: run the hubconf import to automatically build fairseq Cython components if they are missing
